fato_historico: 1979: Typhoon Tip becomes the largest and most intense tropical cyclone ever recorded.
energia_do_dia: The cosmic currents are powerful today, much like the vast swirling energy of a massive, record-breaking storm that once graced our planet. For you, Pisces, this intensity may manifest as a deep emotional tide. It is a good time to navigate your inner waters with grace, allowing your natural intuition to guide you through any turbulent waves toward calm shores.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest winds bow to the quiet wisdom of your gentle soul.
significado_numero: Represents completion and the harmony of your spiritual and material cycles.
conselho: Trust your intuition and find balance amidst the changing tides of your day.
